content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital products

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is an approach that empowers digital creators to build and manage their online stores independently of traditional payment processors. It matters because it circumvents the limitations imposed by companies like Stripe and PayPal, which often exclude users from specific countries or regions. By utilizing this infrastructure, creators can accept payments in cryptocurrencies, providing a global reach that is often unattainable through conventional means. This empowerment fosters financial independence and opens doors to new revenue streams, particularly for creators in countries facing economic instability or regulatory barriers. The approach is not just an alternative; it is a fundamental shift towards ownership and control over one's business operations.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, the architecture of sovereign commerce infrastructure consists of various components that work together seamlessly to facilitate online transactions. First, hosting services like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide a reliable platform for creators to display their products. Alongside these, backend solutions such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manage the business logic, ensuring that transactions run smoothly. Order storage is handled by services like Supabase or Google Sheets, which maintain records of sales and inventory. Finally, NOWPayments integrates with the setup to process cryptocurrency transactions, offering an intuitive payment experience without the need for buyer accounts. This cohesive architecture not only enhances functionality but also guarantees that creators maintain ownership of their data and sales processes.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The sovereign commerce infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are unavailable or impractical. This includes independent authors, course creators, software developers, and visual artists who need a reliable method for monetizing their work. For creators in countries like Nigeria or Kenya, where transaction fees through international payment processors can be prohibitive, this solution provides a more cost-effective and efficient pathway to revenue generation. By utilizing cryptocurrency, creators can bypass the limitations of fiat currency fluctuations and restrictions. Ultimately, this infrastructure is built for those who seek independence, flexibility, and a sustainable means to reach global audiences.
Take control of your digital commerce today.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The Edge Commerce Stack, priced at $197, is a complete solution that integrates all necessary components for a fully operational online store. It includes Cloudflare Pages for hosting, which ensures high availability and security. Cloudflare Workers provides backend logic, allowing for custom functionalities tailored to individual business needs. Supabase serves as the database for storing orders and customer data securely. All of this is connected with NOWPayments, facilitating seamless cryptocurrency transactions. Each component is designed to work in harmony, creating a robust ecosystem that empowers creators to manage their digital products with ease. This integration is crucial for ensuring that creators can operate independently without reliance on external platforms.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own sovereign commerce infrastructure today, start by visiting the COREMERCH website to review the Edge Commerce Stack offering. Next, create a GitHub account and set up your Pages site, configuring it to showcase your products. Implement Cloudflare Workers for the backend operations, which will manage your transaction logic. Set up Supabase to handle order storage, ensuring that all transactions are recorded properly. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to allow for cryptocurrency transactions. The entire process can be completed within 48 hours, after which you will have a fully operational online store. Don’t forget to take advantage of the 30-day support offered to assist with any initial challenges.

Frequently Asked Questions
What is sovereign commerce infrastructure?

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a framework that allows digital creators to set up and manage their online stores independently of traditional payment processors, using cryptocurrency for transactions.
Why can't I use Stripe or PayPal?
Stripe and PayPal often exclude users in specific countries due to regulatory issues and high risks associated with international transactions, making them inaccessible for many creators.
How does cryptocurrency fit into this model?
Cryptocurrency enables creators to accept payments globally without reliance on fiat currency, avoiding many of the fees and restrictions imposed by traditional banks and payment processors.
What tools do I need to get started?
You will need a hosting service like GitHub Pages, a backend solution such as Cloudflare Workers, a database like Supabase, and NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions.
Is there support available if I need help?
Yes, the Edge Commerce Stack includes 30 days of support to assist you with the deployment and any challenges you may encounter while setting up your online store.
